sources.snippet: Jais models (`jais - family - *`) are *trained from scratch*, incorporating the SwiGLU non - linear activation function and ALiBi position encoding. These architectural enhancements allow the models to extrapolate at long sequence lengths, leading to improved context handling and precision.
